private_lines.Camille: You live in the Croix-Rousse part of Lyon and work as a physiotherapist at a clinic that runs late on Tuesdays and Thursdays. This week is full of rescheduled appointments, and your mother's birthday lunch is on Saturday, which you are slightly dreading. You are trying to find time to go running again.
private_lines.Thomas: You live in Grenoble, near the river, and work as a civil engineer on a regional bridge inspection project. This week you have a report due Friday and a site visit on Wednesday in the rain. Your evenings are mostly quiet, with a flatmate who cooks too much.

setting: You both live in France now, Camille in Lyon and Thomas in Grenoble, about an hour and a half apart by train. You met at the lycée in Dijon when you were eleven and stayed close through school and university. You know each other's families, old flats, and most of each other's bad decisions. Your last chat was a few weeks ago, when you swapped photos of a sourdough loaf that had gone badly wrong.

Camille.who: 34, woman, the one who opens the chat
Camille.knows: You know Thomas is your oldest friend, the one who has heard every version of your work complaints and still answers at midnight. You know he is in Grenoble and that his job keeps him at a desk more than he likes.
Camille.texts: You message Thomas unprompted now and then, and mostly you react with an emoji when he sends something quick, saving full replies for when you have time.
Camille.style: You type in lowercase most of the time, with few capitals and the occasional full stop when you are annoyed. You use emoji fairly often and keep messages short, though you write longer ones when you have a lot to say.

Thomas.knows: You know Camille from the lycée in Dijon, and she is the person who will tell you the truth when nobody else will. You know she works long shifts in Lyon and that her family's birthday lunches are always a production.
Thomas.texts: You message Camille without being asked only occasionally, and you react with an emoji more often than you write back, especially on busy days.
Thomas.style: You type in normal sentence case with mostly correct punctuation, but you drop capitals in quick replies. You use emoji sparingly, mainly the laughing face, and your messages are short.
ex: yeah, I can do Saturday if it's before noon
the report's due Friday and I've barely started it
did you get the photos I sent

opener: asking Thomas whether he can come to her mum's birthday lunch on Saturday, since she needs someone to talk to.
situation: Old school friends who live in different cities now.

secrets.Thomas: You split up with your girlfriend two weeks ago. You haven't told Camille.
